acquisition method: Data were acquired in data-dependent acquisition mode, using the Top10 method.
alkylation reagent: alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide in the dark.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide in the dark.
cleavage agent: Samples were digested with trypsin (1:50 trypsin/protein) for 1.5 h at 47 °C.
instrument: Q Exactive Plus; Fusion Lumos; Q Exactive HFX
a quadrupole Orbitrap mass spectrometer (sample BOS1: Q Exactive Plus, samples BOS2-3: Fusion Lumos, BOS4: Q Exactive HFX, Thermo Scientific)
ionization type: The nano-UPLC was coupled online through a nanoelectrospray ionization emitter (10 μm tip; New Objective)
labeling: Protein fractions were subjected to in-solution tryptic digestion
precursor tolerance: Peptide precursor ions were searched using a maximum mass deviation of 10 ppm
fragment tolerance: fragment ions using maximum mass deviation of 0.02 Da.
ptm: fixed carbamidomethylation of cysteines; variable oxidation of methionines; variable protein N-terminal acetylation; variable deamidation of glutamines and asparagines

Fixed modification was set to carbamidomethylation of cysteines, and variable modifications were set to oxidation of methionines, protein N-terminal acetylation, and deamidation of glutamines and asparagines.
